tradeoffs.loses: per-call key overrides (llm's --key flag / API key= param) bypass Router and go straight to OpenAI, billed to that caller; only the default/operator key (stored via 'llm keys set openai' or OPENAI_API_KEY) routes through Router
tradeoffs.why: get_client() builds the OpenAI client with self.get_key(key), which returns an explicit per-call key verbatim when given; routing that through one shared Router key would silently rebill/misattribute another caller's traffic
